Proven correct. Cost: 1.86 cycles per call, clang: 2.87.
Can you make it even faster? If you believe this version is optimal, answer NO_IMPROVEMENT and one sentence why.

attempts.response: NO_IMPROVEMENT — the predicate is `((int32_t)x > 0) || (x==0)` i.e. two disjoint 64-bit intervals (`L in [1,0x7fffffff]` any `H` or `H==0 && L==0`) which cannot be distinguished by a single `icmp`/arithmetic test, so two independent tests (`icmp eq i64 0` and `icmp sgt i32 0`) plus `or` is the minimal data-flow and already dual-issues optimally.
